main.description: Complete a root-identity provisioning flow started by beginRootProvision. Caller submits the signed digest plus the nonce. Backend verifies signature, gates on Council approval, then submits an EtzhayyimAuthz.provisionRoot transaction on the target chain. Returns the chain tx hash + the assigned rootId. Per ADR-2605212030.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed EIP-191 personal_sign signature (65 bytes r||s||v) of the digest issued by beginRootProvision, signed by the requested activeKey.

txHash.description: Base L2 transaction hash for the provisionRoot call.

errors.name: NonceUnknown
errors.description: nonce does not match any pending provisioning session.

errors.name: NonceExpired
errors.description: nonce was valid but expired before completion.

errors.name: SignatureInvalid
errors.description: signature does not recover to the activeKey declared in beginRootProvision.

errors.name: CouncilApprovalRequired
errors.description: the Council multisig has not yet approved this provisioning request.

errors.name: ChainSubmissionFailed
errors.description: the on-chain provisionRoot transaction reverted; see chainError for detail.
